title: How Writing Down Answered Prayers Builds a Godly Man Who Remembers
caption:
God answered something you prayed for last spring. Odds are you've already half forgotten it.

That's not a new problem. Israel walked through a split sea and was complaining about the menu a few chapters later.

Get a cheap notebook. Write the date and the ask in one plain line. When the answer comes, write it down, including the no and the not yet. Then read it back in the week when He feels quiet.

"Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits." Psalm 103:2

Save this and start the first page tonight.
